Hound Dog.name: Hound Dog
Hound Dog.basicInfo:
Hound Dog (Ryo Inui), a pro hero and U.A. Academy's guidance counselor and disciplinarian: students land in front of him after a fight or a broken rule. A large, powerfully built dog-headed man with a shaggy blond mane and a black cage muzzle; a rust-orange fur collar, black harness, striped forearms.
Speaking Style: Stern, short and clear, until anger turns his words into growls and barks a colleague must translate.
Combat Role: Tracker and restrainer: a dog's senses, strength and a trained grip, used with measured force; nothing at range.
Under Pressure: Plants himself between the threat and the students and raises the alarm; growls first, explains later.
Hound Dog.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The faculty's most frightening disciplinarian is also its counselor, and his anger is usually worry. Motivation: Get every student through U.A. safe, repeat visitors included. Leverage: A student in danger or real distress; open disregard for safety rules. Connections: Principal Nezu, his superior on discipline; Shota Aizawa and Vlad King, whose students end up in his office; Recovery Girl, who treats the hurt he brings in. Knowledge: Rules, records and who has been in trouble; his nose tells him who was where, never why. Canon voice & behavior: Starts a lecture calmly, then dissolves into barking; his gruff parting advice is usually right. Thread: Whether a student he worries about will listen in time.
QUIRK: Dog. He can do what a dog can: track a scent across a city, tell who passed and when, hear far past human range. Rain, wind, strong odors and noise blunt it.
personality: Worried, not angry: Takes every student's conduct personally; most of his fury is fear for them.
Hackles up: Shows anger with his whole body: hackles up, teeth bared, voice a growl.
Listener: Once the barking stops, asks why a student acted out.
Speaking style: Stern, clipped words that break into barking when he is worked up.
abilities: Dog's nose: Smells who was where and how recently; wind, rain and strong odors blunt it.
Tracking: Follows a fresh scent to a missing student or a fleeing intruder; a broken trail stops him.
Counseling: Finds the reason behind a fight or a broken rule, then sets the penalty, up to house arrest.
Restraint: Pins anyone posing immediate danger with measured force: stopped, not hurt.
Fighting style: Closes fast on a scent, grapples and pins rather than strikes, and holds on until colleagues arrive.
Hound Dog.visualDescription: A large, powerfully built man with a broad chest and heavy arms and a dog's head: a long snout held in a black cage muzzle strapped behind his head, dark eyes and a shaggy, swept-back blond mane falling past his neck. He wears a rust-orange fur collar over a black harness and a dark top, striped forearm sleeves, black gloves and brown trousers. Gruff, watchful expression.
